figures.finding: The Polish Screenwriters' Guild (Związek Zawodowy Scenarzystów Polskich - Gildia Scenarzystów) is a trade union: a full member needs one produced feature screenplay or series episodes (5 over 40 min or 10 under 40 min), and pays PLN 600 a year; an associate pays PLN 200.

value.name: Związek Zawodowy Scenarzystów Polskich - Gildia Scenarzystów (GSP)
value.full: one produced feature screenplay, or 5 episodes over 40 min / 10 under 40 min
value.associate: a year-long screenwriting course, a contest prize, 3 shorts, or a screenplay accepted but not yet produced

figures.finding: The Polish Film Institute makes producers pay the screenwriter before applying: at least 20% of the fee for the screenplay rights (100% of an option fee) when applying for development or production, and at least 70% of the whole screenplay fee when applying for production after funded development.
